headline: Noah's ARC surges into gold at 12th

sections.text: Noah's ARC gained 21.39 points to reach 73.89, rising from 54th to 12th in the past day.
The move carries the team into the 17 gold places, making it one of the day's strongest advances near the top of the ARC-2 board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
